label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar = param.replace("\"", """) written to HTML response via response.getWriter().println(); user input from request.getParameter reaches the sink expression. Although double-quote encoding occurs, it does not mitigate all XSS vectors (e.g., < > & ' characters remain unencoded in the data-name attribute), making this a real vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param flows through replace() to bar, then bar is embedded in HTML attribute at response.getWriter().println()
